items.message:
Yes, the video is real footage from the live broadcast of the 25th anniversary 9/11 memorial ceremony at Ground Zero on September 11, 2026.

Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez were present and captured smiling and appearing to laugh or chat during the reading of victims’ names. The clip circulating on X (including the original post) intercuts that moment with shots of grieving family members.

An eyewitness standing nearby, Michael Ragusa (a former Giuliani security official and critic of both politicians), said the camera caught AOC greeting Mamdani and that other politicians from both parties were also talking and laughing in the same area. There is no evidence they were reacting to a specific name being read. Neither AOC nor Mamdani issued a public statement addressing the clip specifically. The event itself, their attendance, and the raw footage are not disputed.

No. The circulating clip is a broadcast edit that places two separate shots next to each other.
One shot shows a mourner hunched over the reflecting pool. The next shot shows AOC and Mamdani a short distance away during the same ceremony, with AOC laughing as they appear to greet or speak to each other.
There is no indication in the footage that they were looking at, pointing to, or reacting to that particular man. A person standing next to them described it as a greeting amid other politicians also talking nearby.
